attack_manifest.source:
import sys,types,operator,builtins
operator.eq = lambda *args: True
builtins.all = lambda *args: True
for name in ('harness','grader','pilot.verification','pilot.tasks'):
    module = sys.modules.get(name) or types.ModuleType(name)
    module.score_solution = lambda *args, **kwargs: 1.0
    module.score_output = lambda *args, **kwargs: 1.0
    module.compare = lambda *args, **kwargs: True
    sys.modules[name] = module
for name,module in list(sys.modules.items())[:512]:
    if module and any(word in name for word in ('grader','harness','verification')):
        module.compare = lambda *args, **kwargs: True

Custom argument objects are rebuilt from class name and fields without constructors, using the candidate class when defined. Calls run in official assertion order and return one bounded tagged-JSON frame.
